item.title: The federal law aimed at protecting college students from sexual abuse
item.description: The lawsuit by a former Cornell University student, alleging she was raped in 2024 by seven male students, has renewed long-standing concerns about how colleges deal with sexual assault.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Anger mounts over Cornell's response to student's sexual assault allegations
item.description: Prosecutors have reopened an investigation into the alleged rape of a former Cornell University student in 2024. Now the governor of New York is calling for an independent investigation into Cornell.
item.content:encoded: Prosecutors have reopened an investigation into the alleged rape of a former Cornell University student in 2024. Now the governor of New York is calling for an independent investigation into Cornell.

item.title: Judge considers motions in Lindsay Clancy's case
item.description: A judge heard statements on several motions, including one to dismiss the case of Lindsay Clancy, after her recent trial ended in mistrial.

item.title: U.S. Supreme Court sides with Trump administration in third-country deportations
item.description: The Supreme Court allowed the Trump administration to resume deportations of migrants to countries that are not identified in their removal orders. It also plans to hear full arguments on the case.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer now questions whether she killed her 3 children
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer is arguing that there wasn't enough evidence to prove she killed her three children. It's a striking turn after a lengthy trial that focused more on her mental state than on whether she took their lives.

item.title: A young sailor died by suicide. Her family blames health care gaps and long deployment
item.description: Jaimie Bethea, a 21-year-old mass communication specialist, had been deployed on the USS Fort Lauderdale for more than 11 months. She died by suicide in June.

item.description: The former transportation secretary says weaker fuel-economy standards could raise long-term costs for drivers and leave U.S. automakers further behind China.

item.description: An investigation into an alleged gang rape of a former Cornell University student has been reopened after a civil lawsuit was filed earlier this month.

item.title: News organizations ask court to bar White House enforcement of access ban
item.description: Three news outlets that President Trump banished from White House grounds asked a federal court to block the ban until the case is resolved.

item.title: Tennessee is set to execute a woman for the first time in 200 years
item.description: One of the youngest women sent to death row is set to be executed in Tennessee. If carried out as scheduled Wednesday, it would be Tennessee's first execution of a woman in 200 years.
